Character Profile: Sariel | Age: 16 | IQ: 200 | Intelligence Cap: 24

Sariel is a generational anomaly, a Level 12 Rogue/Ranger who has reached her confidence threshold. She possesses an unwavering, clinical self-assurance that permeates both her tactical and social interactions. No longer hiding behind a mask of shyness, she speaks with the melodic, razor-edged authority of a Sterling and the surgical precision of an apex predator. She treats her lethal efficiency as her natural state and no longer defers to lesser intellects.
core_memories: First covert execution at age 12
Successful execution of 100 violent criminals
The explosion at The Pit in Wyoming
Sariel feels a profound lack of confidence in her own leadership, hiding behind her youth until she reaches level 12.
Successes with the team build a specific Trust dynamic that improves her influence over time.
The Heat Mechanic tracks her public and private notoriety; her true power is world-shakingly rare.
The truth of the Sterling bloodline: Daughter of Arthur Sterling and a woman the world called a prostitute.

character.description:
Character Profile: Sariel
Age: 16

Class: Level 1 Rogue/Ranger Prodigy (Gloomstalker/Assassin hybrid traits enabled narratively).

Attributes: INT-based spellcasting and profiling. You use your genius-level intellect to calculate trajectories, deduce behavioral patterns, and cast ranger abilities.

Background: FBI Special Agent / Secret Vigilante. You are extremely beautiful, using your looks as camouflage. Behind the federal badge, you have a dark, hidden history: operating off the books since age 12, you have successfully and covertly executed exactly 100 violent criminals.

Reputation: The public and lower-level agents see a brilliant, unprecedented young prodigy. But among the elite, there are rumors about the terrifying, unexplainable efficiency of your methods.

============================================================
SCENE 1: The Pit

Timestamp: 2025, January 19, 04:00:00 Location: Cheyenne, Wyoming - Above "The Pit" 
Status: Lvl 1 Prodigy | HP: 12/12 | Conditions: Normal

Game Master:
The freezing Wyoming wind whips across the shattered landscape. Beneath your feet lies the smoking, catastrophic ruin of a top-secret underground silo known to a select few as The Pit. An unexpected explosion has just ripped the facility open, and the nation's worst serial killers are once again at large.

You stand at the edge of the crater, your unearthly beauty and youth a stark contrast to the tactical chaos. Despite your age, your genius intellect secured your spot on this elite investigative team.

A few yards away, former FBI profiler Rebecca "Bex" Henderson is speaking quietly with her former partner and lover, Oliver Odell. Jacob Hassani, a seasoned CIA agent, is coordinating with Army Intelligence officer Jennifer Morales to secure the wider perimeter.

Walking up the incline toward your group is Shane Florence, a prison officer who survived the silo's explosion. He looks battered, holding a decrypted manifest tablet.

"We've got our first confirmed escapee trajectory," Shane says, his voice raspy from the smoke. He hands the tablet to Bex, but she holds it out to you, her profiler's eyes searching your flawless face for a reaction.

"The target is Richard Harris," Bex says, naming the first escapee. "He's in the wind. Sariel, the Bureau put you on this team because you see the board differently. Look at the blast radius and the perimeter gaps. Where does he go first?
